introduction.title: Blueprints
introduction.explanation: A program can be a blueprint. Every robot built from it runs the same cards, from its own start, with its own memory.

realWords.text: A blueprint is a class. It lists what every robot built from it remembers and what it can do. A function inside a class, like main, is called a method.
new builds one robot from the class. Each robot built is called an instance, or an object. The arguments say where this one starts and which way it faces.
Inside a class, this means the robot that is running the line right now. this.steps is that robot's own steps, not another robot's.
Bot extends Robot means a Bot starts with everything a Robot can do, like forward, and adds its own. Getting abilities from another class is called inheritance.
